data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate began 2014 with gross claims outstanding of 3,238.5m (USD). During 2014 the syndicate released prior year reserves totalling $149.6m, driven by generally favourable claims development and notable releases in the reinsurance and political risks & contingency divisions. There was minimal natural catastrophe exposure overall, with only a small exposure to Hurricane Odile reported on the property and reinsurance books.
raw_causal_phrases: claims have developed favourably during 2014, with claims notifications at normalised levels.
There has been minimal exposure to natural catastrophes throughout the year, with a small exposure to Hurricane Odile seen on the property and reinsurance books.
During 2014 we were able to release prior year reserves of $149.6m (2013: $215.7m).
The reduction in reserve releases in 2014 compared to 2013 was driven by the exceptional releases seen in 2013 in the reinsurance and political risks and contingency divisions.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, gross) as at 31 Dec 2013 (prior-year column). Prior-year development taken from the Managing Agent strategic report narrative/table showing 'release prior year reserves of $149.6m' (treated as a gross figure). Technical reserves reconciliation shows a smaller 'movement in the provision' figure for gross claims ((54.6)m) - that line appears to be the total movement during the year including current-year activity and exchange adjustments; the strategic report's division table was used as the primary prior-year movement source. All monetary values are reported in the report's functional currency (USD millions). Mapping of the syndicate divisional labels to standard Lloyd's LOB names was done where unambiguous; mapping for 'Political risks & contingency' to 'Casualty' and 'Reinsurance' to 'Treaty' is judgemental.
